name: ecom Smart-Ex 02 DZ2
statusNote: Distributors list it as end of life, with the Smart-Ex 03 as its replacement.
summary: The ecom Smart-Ex 02 DZ2 is an intrinsically safe (Ex ic) smartphone from ecom (Pepperl+Fuchs), certified for Zone 2/22 under ATEX and IECEx, and for Class I Division 2 in North America. It runs Android 11, with a user-replaceable battery. It has been discontinued; the ecom Smart-Ex 03 DZ2 replaces it.

atex.marking: II 3G Ex ic op is IIC T4 Gc IP64 / II 3D Ex ic op is IIIC T120°C Dc

iecex.marking: Ex ic IIC T4 Gc IP64 / Ex ic IIIC T120°C Dc

certification.northAmerica: Cl I, II, III Div 2 Groups A-G T4; Cl I Zn 2 AEx ic IIC T4 Gc; Zn 22 AEx ic IIIC T120°C Dc
certification.protection: Intrinsic safety (Ex ic) with inherently safe optical radiation (op is)

safety.conditions: Use only Ex-BP S02 or Ex-BP S02C battery packs; battery pack charged separately in non-hazardous area; do not swap battery covers between devices
